title: GlobalEd Revenue Forecast Output
description: Required forecast output metrics for the 60-month projection period (Jan 2024 - Dec 2028). All monetary values in USD rounded to 2 decimal places.

net_revenue_month_1.description: Total USD net revenue (after tax, probability-weighted ECL, and FX with hedge effectiveness testing) across all countries and tiers for forecast month 1 (Jan 2024)

net_revenue_month_12.description: Total USD net revenue for forecast month 12 (Dec 2024)

net_revenue_month_24.description: Total USD net revenue for forecast month 24 (Dec 2025)

net_revenue_month_36.description: Total USD net revenue for forecast month 36 (Dec 2026)

net_revenue_month_48.description: Total USD net revenue for forecast month 48 (Dec 2027)

net_revenue_month_60.description: Total USD net revenue for forecast month 60 (Dec 2028)

cumulative_net_revenue.description: Sum of total USD net revenue across all 60 forecast months

first_price_change_month_usa.description: 1-indexed month number of the first consensus-triggered price adjustment in the USA market

first_price_change_month_aus.description: 1-indexed month number of the first consensus-triggered price adjustment in the Australia market

first_price_change_month_uk.description: 1-indexed month number of the first consensus-triggered price adjustment in the UK market

total_subscribers_month_60.description: Total subscriber count across all countries and tiers at forecast month 60, rounded to nearest integer

usa_professional_charged_price_month_36.description: The effective charged price (USD) for the USA Professional tier at forecast month 36

cumulative_ecl_provision_usd.description: Total probability-weighted expected credit loss provision in USD summed across all 60 months, all countries, all tiers

cumulative_hedge_gain_usd.description: Cumulative FX hedge gain (positive) or loss (negative) in USD over 60 months, computed only for hedges that pass the IFRS 9 effectiveness test

aus_effective_fx_rate_2026.description: The blended effective AUD-to-USD conversion rate for fiscal year 2026 (hedge_ratio * forward_rate + (1-hedge_ratio) * spot_rate if hedge is effective, or spot_rate if dedesignated), rounded to 4 decimal places

npv_cumulative_revenue.description: Net present value of all 60 months of net revenue, discounted using the bootstrapped zero-coupon yield curve derived from par bond rates. Rounded to 2 decimal places.

effective_hedge_count.description: Number of active hedge contracts (out of 10) that pass the IFRS 9 dollar-offset cumulative effectiveness test (ratio within effectiveness bounds).

weighted_avg_ecl_rate.description: Simple average of the probability-weighted ECL rates across all 5 subscription tiers. Rounded to 6 decimal places.
